subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The African elephant is a species of mammal.
• It can be found in Kenya and Tanzania.
• The African elephant primarily eats grass and bark.
• It has an average weight of 6,000 pounds.
prompt: The student wants to specify the average weight of the African elephant. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The African elephant has an average weight of 6,000 pounds.
choices.B: The African elephant can be found in Kenya and Tanzania.
choices.C: One species of mammal found in Tanzania primarily eats grass and bark.
choices.D: The African elephant is a mammal that primarily eats grass and bark.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence specifies the average weight of the African elephant: 6,000 pounds.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. While the sentence provides information about the African elephant, it doesn't specify the African elephant's average weight.
